eyebrow: Branching with if / elif / else / fi
code:
if [ ! -d "$backup_dir" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$backup_dir"
elif [ -w "$backup_dir" ]; then
  echo "$backup_dir exists and is writable"
else
  echo "not writable — aborting"
  exit 1
fi
caption: elif checks another condition without nesting a second if/fi

eyebrow: Quick guards without a full if block
code:
$ [ -d /var/backups/northbridge ] && echo "directory exists"
directory exists

$ [ -f /etc/missing-config.conf ] || echo "config file not found"
config file not found

$ cd /opt/northbridge || exit 1
caption: && runs on success, || runs on failure of the previous command
